You are an independent AIDA reviewer seat, launched by the product seat for Joe. Review PR #2242 at exact head 623ee41c3dbb4f1fc7531f238e15d2061ac1dd44, focusing on its last advisor-written commit `623ee41c3dbb4f1fc7531f238e15d2061ac1dd44` (the RAII guard fix). Do not merge, approve on GitHub, change merge-holds, or change code. The advisor/integrator owns disposition and merge.

Read BUG-1673. The requested confirm review is the last commit atop branch `claude/bug-1673`; also inspect surrounding implementation as needed to establish the commit is safe. Use `git show --stat --oneline 623ee41c3dbb4f1fc7531f238e15d2061ac1dd44` and `git show --format=fuller 623ee41c3dbb4f1fc7531f238e15d2061ac1dd44`, and compare the complete PR branch with origin/main where useful. Probe that the warning sink cleanup is safe on panic/unwind, thread-local isolation remains sound, and the review's assertions cover the actual behavior. The PR is behind main; don't rebase it. Review exact requested head.

Use an isolated scratch worktree at that exact SHA for any build/tests. You have `--add-dir /run/user/1000/cargo-slots-1000` for cargo commands; use it. Do not use `--lib` or in-file-only invocation. Verify test output reports nonzero tests passed. No code changes. Report concise evidence, runnable commands and exact test counts. End with `VERDICT: APPROVE` or `VERDICT: REQUEST_CHANGES`; if a correctness/integrity issue exists, name file/line and concrete reproduction. Record the AIDA verdict against BUG-1673 with the exact SHA and branch `claude/bug-1673`, then report the result. Do not record approved if you have any blocker. Do not merge.
